title: The Pale Smile
author: Xanthe Okafor
blurb: Xanthe Amberdale, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, has spent twenty years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
